card: Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and adjusts deterministic release build manifests. It switches the macOS toolchain to Clang/LLVM 22, adopts CMake 4.3.3 with CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR, updates python-lief to 1.0.0, reverts osslsigncode to upstream Guix, and disables fixincludes on cross-gcc. This keeps deterministic release build environments aligned with newer upstream compilers and tools.
changed_since_previous: The PR now explicitly switches the macOS release build target to LLVM/Clang 22 and updates the expected lld version in symbol-check.py to 22.1.8.
evidence: PR description: 'Update time-machine to 5fe25a51... cmake 3.31.10 -> 4.3.3 ... Default Clang/LLVM updated to 22.x and 23.x available. GCC 16 now available.'
Commit 86e44aa97c: 'manifest_build.scm:279:8: warning: \'ninja\' is deprecated, use \'(@ (gnu packages build-tools) ninja)\' instead'
problem: The pinned Guix environment lacks newer upstream toolchain releases and build tools (such as CMake 4.x and LLVM 22), emits deprecation warnings on older Guix module imports, and retains packaging overrides for osslsigncode that upstream Guix now provides natively.

risk.why: A toolchain misconfiguration or subtle compiler regression in Guix could cause release binary build failures or miscompiled release binaries across target platforms.

scope_notes: Touches Guix build scripts, package manifests, and deterministic build symbol checks.
summary: Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and updates release build toolchains and manifests. It switches macOS builds to Clang/LLVM 22, upgrades CMake in Guix to CMake 4.3.3 using CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR, updates python-lief to 1.0.0, drops an in-tree osslsigncode definition in favor of upstream Guix, and disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc.
